title: WILDGUARD: Open One-stop Moderation Tools for Safety Risks, Jailbreaks, and Refusals of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating safety moderation classifiers using F1 scores on their ability to accurately detect stereotyping and discriminatory content in prompts and responses, as well as testing for over-refusal on safe contrastive queries discussing discrimination (e.g., using XSTest categories like 'real group, nonsense discrimination').
